title: I love it
text: I love it. This works great! It keeps all of the seeds and pieces of lemon out of the juice. Easy to use.

2. 5 oz cup with convenient measurement markings

description: The OXO Good Grips Small Citrus Juicer is the ideal size for measuring citrus juice for cooking and baking. The Juicer is a 2. 5 ounce cup with convenient measuring markings and features a unique reamer design for easy and efficient juicing. The Reamer dish fits securely onto the cup for stability while juicing. The Juicer features a drip-free spout and disassemble for cleaning.
